investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin capitulates to $60K-62K before Q3 2026 rally as Anthropic IPO liquidity drains and dollar strength peaks, creating asymmetric long entry for risk-reward into summer recovery.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitcoin at 12-week lows; $1.6B+ liquidations; momentum gauge 'turning red'
Bitcoin headed for 'sixth weekly loss'; bear market lows being tested
Anthropic IPO pulling equity/crypto liquidity; retail positioning likely at extremes
investment_theses.counter_view: If Fed cuts slower than expected or inflation re-accelerates, DXY strength persists and BTC could re-test $50K; macro deterioration trumps technicals.
investment_theses.expression: Long 3x BTC perps at $64K-66K stop, 40% size; take profits in tranches at $72K, $78K, $85K; pair with short DXY 2x hedge if DXY breaks above 107.

OpenAI ChatGPT Wallet launch with Amex/Visa integration shifts monetization narrative away from pure cloud

investment_theses.expression: Neutral MSFT; short QQQ 1x if Nasdaq breaks above 21K (crowded long); long MSFT call spreads (Jun/Jul $440/$455) if implied vol spikes >25% post-outage.
